C9000007.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 007 (Ordinary two-point correlations and the corrected Elliott conjecture.; papers: Ordinary two-point correlations of multiplicative functions; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/007.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_FOREST_UNIFORM.statement: For n>=1 and r>=1, the union over all fields, coefficients, lit sets and block choices satisfying the stated geometry and joint-pair bound has at most 2^(10n+3)(2n)^((6r-4)B+I) equality patterns, with one coefficient-free injective encoding and decoder.

C_FOREST_QUOTIENT.statement: A maximal m-pair independent collection omits exactly 2m coordinate labels; every remaining label's lit starts lie on one line in its nonzero independent quotient direction.

C_FOREST_PATH.statement: Independent-direction incidence graphs are forests, and nonzero regular runs give the unique simple endpoint path for every regular segment.

C_FOREST_DECODER.statement: The discrete masks, typed ordered forest, endpoint pairs and representative positions recover the entire equality pattern, including imperfect-only labels, uniformly over numerical witnesses.

C_FOREST_COUNT.statement: The same finite code universe has size at most 2^(10n+3)(2n)^((6r-4)B+I); choosing the first decoding code injects the union over all witnesses.

C_FOREST_GEOMETRY.statement: The literal nonzero mixed-difference terms supply lit blocks with interval-shaped occurrences and nonzero run sums by the prohibited-word deletion argument, without translated-residue independence.

C_FOREST_SPECIALIZATION.statement: The structural theorem recovers the literal q:forest-code bound exp(2048k) per column and exp(2048Jk) in all columns, for every admissible coefficient and padding choice, for L>=1024.

C_FOREST_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal maximal-pair saturation, independent-vector cycle exclusion, forest endpoint decoding, record/code-cardinality bounds, and a union-over-witnesses injection under one shared decoder law; not an end-to-end formalization of the witness encoder.
